name: 16x2 I2C LCD Display
fullName: 16x2 Character LCD Module with PCF8574 I2C Serial Backpack
tagline: Liquid crystal alphanumeric display with I2C 2-wire serial interface
description: A standard 16-character by 2-line alphanumeric LCD display based on the HD44780 controller, pre-soldered with a PCF8574 I2C expander backpack. Reduces the required GPIO lines from 16 to just 2 I2C pins (SDA & SCL).

specs.backlight: Blue backlight with white text / Yellow-Green with black text
specs.contrast: Adjustable via onboard blue potentiometer on I2C backpack

pinout.name: I2C Data
pinout.desc: Serial data line (Arduino A4 / ESP8266 D2 / ESP32 GPIO21)

pinout.name: I2C Clock
pinout.desc: Serial clock line (Arduino A5 / ESP8266 D1 / ESP32 GPIO22)

wiringNote: If the screen lights up with solid white rectangles, adjust the contrast potentiometer on the back of the I2C backpack with a small screwdriver.
commonMistakes: Using wrong I2C address (0x27 vs 0x3F — run an I2C scanner sketch to verify)
Contrast potentiometer set all the way to minimum or maximum making text invisible
